WITH s AS (
 SELECT p.sku, f.net_amount, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.sales_line_id
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id<>999),
r AS (
 SELECT p.sku, sum(rl.refund_net) refund_net, sum(rl.quantity_returned) ret_qty
 FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=rl.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=rl.store_key
 WHERE rl.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1),
a AS (SELECT sku, sum(net_amount) gross_net, sum(quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_net FROM s GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.sku, (SELECT max(product_name) FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku AND d.is_current) nm, a.gross_net, a.units, a.staff_net, coalesce(r.refund_net,0) refund, coalesce(r.ret_qty,0) retq, a.gross_net-coalesce(r.refund_net,0) net_after, rank() over (order by a.gross_net desc) rk_gross, rank() over (order by a.gross_net-coalesce(r.refund_net,0) desc) rk_net, rank() over (order by a.units desc) rk_units
FROM a LEFT JOIN r USING(sku) QUALIFY rk_gross<=14 OR rk_net<=14 OR rk_units<=14 ORDER BY rk_net

SELECT p.sku, p.product_key, p.product_name, p.category, p.vat_class, p.standard_unit_cost, p.listed_from, p.delisted_on, p.valid_from, p.valid_to, p.is_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.product_key=p.product_key AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') n,
 (SELECT round(sum(net_amount)/sum(quantity),2) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.product_key=p.product_key AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') unit_price,
 (SELECT round(avg(gross_amount/nullif(net_amount,0)),3) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.product_key=p.product_key AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') g2n,
 (SELECT max(vat_rate) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.product_key=p.product_key AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') vr
FROM dim_product p WHERE p.sku IN (100955,100927,103415,103434,103329,102116,101411,101398,101375,101022,103697,101763) ORDER BY p.sku, p.valid_from

calls.statement:
WITH per AS (
  SELECT start_date AS d0, end_date AS d1 FROM (SELECT period_start_date AS start_date, period_end_date AS end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5)
),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  CROSS JOIN per
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1 AND st.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY p.sku
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net) AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  CROSS JOIN per
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1 AND st.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY p.sku
)
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY s.amt - coalesce(r.amt,0) DESC) AS rank,
       s.sku,
       (SELECT max(d.product_name) FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku = s.sku AND d.is_current) AS product_name,
       round(s.amt - coalesce(r.amt,0), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sku)
ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC LIMIT 10
